description: The modules of the platform and what each may depend on, per side (backend packages, frontend folders). One source for three checks: backend/…/architecture/ModulesTest (ArchUnit), frontend/eslint.config.js (imports) and scripts/test-affected.sh (which tests a change needs). Explained in docs/architecture.md.

core.purpose: Shared foundation: sign-in and rights, people, teams, seasons, lines, tiles, errors, clock. Frontend: shared services, texts, API types and the shell.

notification.purpose: Notifications in the app, by e-mail and by push, with exchangeable channels.

attendance.purpose: Tile «Anwesenheit»: events, series, responses, call-up, attendance check, warnings, event variants, absences, calendar, special line-ups.

swissunihockey.purpose: Match days, matches and league tables from swiss unihockey, behind their own layer with a simulator.

driver.purpose: Tile «Fahrerliste»: driver list of a match day, driver plan of the season, routes and timeline.

statistics.purpose: Attendance statistics per person and team.

testsupport.purpose: Test support: the seed and the test endpoints (reset, clock, sign-in), present only in dev, test and preview. Every test starts from the seed, so a change here runs everything.

app.purpose: Composition in the frontend: the pages that combine several modules (start, profile, teams, administration, assistants) and the routes.
